sections.title: Independent Research Workshop
sections.description: Students in this course will carry out their own social science research project relating to social work, social policy, nonprofit leadership, or other social justice topics. Students must complete an introductory research course prior to enrolling—SWRK6150, MSSP6290, NPL5830, NPL7200 or the equivalent. Students must also have an approved research proposal and IRB approval prior to the start of the course. All students will be expected to prepare a publishable research paper by the end of the semester.
